description: This file defines functions and types related to handling unsupported secret reference surfaces and configuration candidates within a specific module, including dynamic module loading and pattern collection.

methods.name: loadBundledChannelContractSurfacesModule
methods.description: Loads the module containing channel contract surfaces, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: listChannelUnsupportedSecretRefSurfaces
methods.description: Retrieves the list of channel unsupported secret reference surfaces from the loaded module.

methods.name: collectChannelUnsupportedSecretRefSurfacePatterns
methods.description: Collects all unsupported secret reference surface patterns from channel surfaces.

methods.name: getUnsupportedSecretRefSurfacePatterns
methods.description: Returns combined list of core and channel-specific unsupported secret reference patterns, with caching.

methods.name: collectUnsupportedSecretRefConfigCandidates
methods.description: Collects configuration candidates for unsupported secrets from raw input, including commands, hooks, and channel surfaces.
